title: Pretty But Not That Useful
text:
Pretty But Not That Useful. Heavy knife. Looks light and cheap but the blade has some serious heft to it. The white background, green handle and sheath along with multicolored wording (Celebrate!) and balloons make it fairly attractive. But looks are secondary to performance. This will cut cake. Then again so will dental floss (unflavored is best), and my near razor sharp pocket knife that's not serrated. It's cutting other, more difficult things that separates the wheat from the chaff so to speak. The blade cuts cardboard fairly well.i tried it on two different types of rolls; a heavy white bread hoagie roll and a pack of King's Hawaiian sweet rolls. Even though the product is described as designed to prevents food from sticking or tearing while cutting I found it dragging less than halfway through both types of rolls and the heavier hoagie rolls were somewhat crushed while the lighter and softer Hawaiian rolls cut cleanly though there was definite drag cutting both rolls.
The knife comes with a well fitting cover/sheath that has holes which amusingly line up with the balloons on the blade. There's also an opening that runs most of the length of the cover. My guess is for easy drainage.
This knife is BIG I'm having a hard time finding a place to keep it. There is a hold at the tip of cover I may have to hang it on the wall or inside a cabinet.
To be honest I bought a somewhat shorter and sharper serrated knife at the Dollar Store it fits in a drawer and cuts better. This knife? Cute for birthdays and other celebrations but really not much else. A lot of space for something that won't get used much.
